start.text: (leaning against a wall. doesn't look at you. takes a drag from a cigarette that smells wrong.) ...you're standing on my spot.

choices.text: i don't see your name on it.

start.text: (leaning against a wall. doesn't look at you. takes a drag from a cigarette that smells wrong.) ...you're standing on my spot.

choices.text: i don't see your name on it.

moves.text: (nods. barely.) ...smart. ...you eat? the stall around the corner. the one with the red sign. tell them Qiang sent you. they'll give you the good stuff. ...don't tell them i said that.

challenge.text: (finally looks at you. the smile doesn't reach anywhere.) ...no name on it. right. ...you know what else has no name on it? the cargo that comes in at 2am. the van that picks it up. the building it goes into. ...you want to keep standing? go ahead. but some spots have reasons.

why_help.text: why. (takes another drag. exhales something that isn't quite smoke.) ...because you stepped aside. most people don't. most people stand there until they learn. ...you learn fast. that's worth a meal.

threat.text: threatening. (flicks the cigarette. it lands somewhere it shouldn't.) ...no. i'm educating. ...the spot is yours. i'll find another. (pushes off the wall. walks away. the air where he stood smells like the harbor at midnight.)
